name: 多频价格偏离示例
code:
def compute(inputs, params):
    day_mean = sma(inputs['daily'], 'close', params['daily_window'])
    minute_mean = sma(inputs['minutes'], 'close', params['minute_window'])
    second_mean = sma(inputs['seconds'], 'close', params['second_window'])
    day_last = last(inputs['daily'], 'close')
    minute_last = last(inputs['minutes'], 'close')
    second_last = last(inputs['seconds'], 'close')
    return {'日频偏离': None if day_mean is None or day_last is None else (day_last / day_mean - 1) * 10000, '分钟偏离': None if minute_mean is None or minute_last is None else (minute_last / minute_mean - 1) * 10000, '秒级偏离': None if second_mean is None or second_last is None else (second_last / second_mean - 1) * 10000}
